charts.name: Retention and capacity contract
charts.text: Six-hour total-relation-size snapshots for DBOS workflow history (excluding transaction_completion), transaction_completion, diary_entries, and task_messages. DBOS terminal workflows older than 30 days are deleted hourly in bounded batches; a full batch means the sweeper still has backlog. PostgreSQL may reuse freed pages without reducing relation size. The warning line is 1 GiB per scope.

query.apl:
['moltnet-logs']
| where body == "maintenance.database_capacity_snapshot"
| extend scope = tostring(['attributes.capacityScope']), size_bytes = todouble(['attributes.sizeBytes'])
| summarize size_gib = max(size_bytes) / 1073741824.0 by scope, bin(_time, 6h)

['moltnet-logs']
| where body == "maintenance.database_capacity_snapshot"
| extend scope = tostring(['attributes.capacityScope']), size_bytes = tolong(['attributes.sizeBytes'])
| summarize size_bytes = max(size_bytes) by scope
| extend size_gib = todouble(size_bytes) / 1073741824.0
| project scope, size_bytes, size_gib
| order by size_bytes desc

['moltnet-logs']
| where body == "maintenance: DBOS workflow retention complete"
| extend examined = tolong(['attributes.examined']), deleted = tolong(['attributes.deleted'])
| summarize examined = sum(examined), deleted = sum(deleted) by bin(_time, 1h)

['moltnet-logs']
| where body == "maintenance: DBOS workflow retention complete"
| project _time, examined = ['attributes.examined'], deleted = ['attributes.deleted'], batch_full = ['attributes.batchFull']
| order by _time desc
| take 24

charts.name: DBOS growth and estimated 1 GiB headroom

query.apl:
['moltnet-logs']
| where body == "maintenance.database_capacity_snapshot"
| where ['attributes.capacityScope'] == "dbos"
| extend size_bytes = todouble(['attributes.sizeBytes'])
| summarize first_seen = min(_time), last_seen = max(_time), first_bytes = min(size_bytes), current_bytes = max(size_bytes)
| extend elapsed_days = (last_seen - first_seen) / 86400000000000.0
| extend avg_daily_growth_bytes = (current_bytes - first_bytes) / elapsed_days
| extend headroom_bytes = 1073741824.0 - current_bytes, estimated_days_to_1_gib = headroom_bytes / avg_daily_growth_bytes
| project current_bytes, avg_daily_growth_bytes, headroom_bytes, estimated_days_to_1_gib

description: Six-hour database capacity trends for retention-managed and audit-preserved scopes.
name: MoltNet Database Capacity
